llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究Ni/Fe基高温合金的SLM工艺，与生物医学方向的应力屏蔽、多孔结构、疲劳或骨整合无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures for stiffness matching, LPBF fabrication for biomedical implants, fatigue testing, or surface roughness/osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM工艺参数对Ni/Fe超合金微观结构和物理性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用选择性激光熔化制备样品并进行微观组织表征和力学测试
summary_zh.result: 优化工艺参数可获得高致密度和良好力学性能的合金
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM、EBSD和力学实验验证微观结构和性能

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of Selective Laser Melting parameters on the microstructure and physical properties of a Ni/Fe-based superalloy.
summary_en.method: Samples were fabricated by SLM with varying parameters and characterized by SEM, EBSD, and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Optimized processing parameters yield near-full density and improved mechanical strength.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural analysis and mechanical tests confirmed the relationships between parameters and properties.
